svg.text: 21% of multi-product vendors have left the marketplace entirely
One mark per vendor with 3 or more listings ever seen, n=501, coloured by how much of its catalogue is still on sale.
FOR
Anyone depending on a vendor's catalogue
rather than one listing
DECIDE
Whether to treat a vendor's presence as more
stable than a product's
WRONG IF
Almost no vendor loses everything — exits are
per-product, not per-vendor
lost EVERY listing
lost some, kept some
lost nothing
A vendor is inferred from the slug's leading token, which is NOT a published field — Snowflake exposes
no vendor anywhere reachable. It groups 501 multi-listing vendors out of 1,356 distinct tokens, so it is
a usable proxy and not a census.
Snowflake Marketplace sitemap, 41 snapshots 2023-03-07 to 2026-09-24. Vendor SIZE does not predict survival: listings from
one-product and ten-plus-product vendors reach two years at 62.5% and 61.0% respectively, flat across every band. Whether a vendor
leaves matters; how big it is does not.
